title: GST Structure Under Review
content: The GST Council has proposed a simplified two-slab structure (5% and 18%) for essential goods. This could streamline compliance and impact pricing strategies for many formulations.

title: AI for Smarter Credit
content: Distributors are using AI-driven credit assessments to predict retailer payment cycles. This technology can offer better terms to reliable pharmacies and improve the financial health of the entire supply chain.

title: Central Licensing for Sterile Drugs
content: To ensure consistent quality, the government is moving to a centralized licensing system for high-risk sterile drugs like injections. This follows quality concerns found during recent state-level inspections.

title: Predictive Analytics for Stock
content: Leading distributors are using AI-powered forecasting to predict demand for low-volume, high-value medicines weeks in advance. This ensures critical drugs are stocked before a patient needs them.

title: NPPA Price Revisions
content: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) periodically revises ceiling prices for essential medicines. Regularly check for updates to ensure your MRP and margins are compliant.
